moderation.section_conduct_body: Treat other shoppers and sellers with respect. Do not harass, threaten, impersonate, or abuse anyone. You are responsible for every listing, comment, and message you post.
moderation.section_prohibited_body: You may not post content that is illegal, hateful, sexually explicit, violent, fraudulent, misleading, spam, or otherwise objectionable. Fake listings, scams, and abusive behavior are prohibited.
moderation.section_reporting_body: Every listing, comment, message, and profile has a Report option. Choose a reason and submit it. MartIt reviews reports within 24 hours and removes objectionable content.
moderation.section_blocking_body: You can block any user from their listing, profile, comment, or chat. Blocking hides their content from you and prevents further contact. Manage blocked users in Settings.
moderation.section_termination_body: There is zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users. Any user who posts objectionable content or engages in abusive behavior will have their content removed and may be banned from the app. MartIt may suspend or delete accounts that break these terms.
